Overview

Novosibirsk is a city in Novosibirsk Oblast with a population of 1,620,000. The largest city in Siberia, a major scientific and industrial center with the renowned Akademgorodok research hub. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
